hints: When you reach an operator, which two numbers does it apply to? What has to have happened to them already?
The two most recently produced values - which are exactly the two most recently *pushed*, if you keep produced values on a stack.
Push every number. On an operator, pop two, combine them, push the result. The line ends with one value on the stack, and that is the answer.
The order of the two pops matters for `-` and `/`: the first value popped is the right-hand operand.
